column1: # Field knowledge that overrides the automated classification.
# The measured rules cannot know what a road is *for*: a graded track that a
# vehicle has been driven along is not the same as a road in use. Where someone
# who knows the ground says otherwise
# rather than by quietly bending a threshold until the answer comes out right.
# stop            the market stop or village the statement is about
# access          road | track  — what it actually has now
# upgradeable     yes | no      — whether the existing track could carry a road
